entries.name: Argenmieles
entries.what_it: Marchio di miele del gruppo NEXCO; vende miele sfuso, in favo e confezionato.
entries.what_en: Honey brand of the NEXCO group; sells bulk, comb and packed honey.

entries.name: NEXCO S.A.
entries.what_it: Lavora ed esporta miele dal proprio stabilimento a Lobos, provincia di Buenos Aires.
entries.what_en: Processes and exports honey from its plant in Lobos, Buenos Aires province.

entries.name: Capilano Honey Ltd
entries.what_it: Compra miele dagli apicoltori fornitori, lo analizza, lo miscela e lo confeziona.
entries.what_en: Buys honey from supplying beekeepers, tests, blends and packs it.

entries.name: Honey Paradise Australia
entries.what_it: Produce e lavora miele australiano ed esporta anche a container pieni o parziali.
entries.what_en: Produces and processes Australian honey and exports it, including full container and part-container loads.

entries.name: NovaFarms Honey
entries.what_it: Azienda familiare di Adelaide che fornisce miele di Manuka e miele naturale.
entries.what_en: Family-run Adelaide business that supplies Manuka and natural honey.

entries.name: Adolf Darbo AG
entries.what_it: Azienda alimentare che ha il miele tra le sue linee di prodotto, accanto a confetture e altro.
entries.what_en: Food company with honey among its product lines, next to jams and more.

entries.name: Meli (Meli NV)
entries.what_it: Marchio di miele che seleziona miele da apicoltori nel mondo e lo miscela in Belgio.
entries.what_en: Honey brand that sources honey from beekeepers worldwide and blends it in Belgium.

entries.name: Weyn's Honing
entries.what_it: Acquista miele da apicoltori nel mondo, lo controlla, lo filtra e lo confeziona per i propri negozi e rivenditori.
entries.what_en: Buys honey from beekeepers worldwide, tests, filters and packs it for its own shops and retailers.

entries.name: Organic Bee Products OOD (Top's Honey)
entries.what_it: Produce miele dai propri apiari e lo confeziona nel proprio stabilimento con il marchio Top's Honey; vende a negozi, ristorazione e apicoltori.
entries.what_en: Produces honey from its own apiaries and packs it in its own plant under the Top's Honey brand; sells to retail, hospitality and beekeepers.

entries.name: Royal Bees EOOD
entries.what_it: Produce e commercia miele e prodotti dell'alveare.
entries.what_en: Produces and trades honey and hive products.

entries.name: Apidouro Comercial Exportadora e Importadora Ltda.
entries.what_it: Produce miele biologico da alveari certificati in varie regioni del Brasile e lo esporta all'estero.
entries.what_en: Produces organic honey from certified hives in several Brazilian regions and exports it abroad.

entries.name: BeeMaid Honey Limited
entries.what_it: Cooperativa di apicoltori canadesi che raccoglie il miele dei soci e lo confeziona e vende come miele canadese.
entries.what_en: Co-operative of Canadian beekeepers that sources its members' honey and packs and sells it as Canadian honey.

entries.name: Apicoop
entries.what_it: Cooperativa di apicoltori che vende ed esporta miele.
entries.what_en: Beekeepers' cooperative that sells and exports honey.

entries.name: JPM Exportaciones
entries.what_it: Esporta miele dal Cile.
entries.what_en: Exports honey from Chile.

entries.name: Delee Foods Group Co., Ltd
entries.what_it: Produce ed esporta miele naturale e prodotti dell'alveare, in vasetti, lattine e sfuso.
entries.what_en: Makes and exports natural honey and bee products, in jars, tins and bulk.

entries.name: Medokom (Medokomerc)
entries.what_it: Acquista miele ceco e da fornitori europei e sudamericani, lo confeziona in vasetti e secchi e lo distribuisce a catene, online e all'ingrosso.
entries.what_en: Buys Czech honey and honey from European and South American suppliers, packs it in jars and buckets and distributes it to chains, online and wholesale.

entries.name: Honig-Schmidt GmbH
entries.what_it: Azienda familiare che acquista, confeziona e vende miele e prodotti apistici.
entries.what_en: Family firm that buys, fills and sells honey and bee products.

entries.name: Honig-Wernet
entries.what_it: Azienda che confeziona e vende miele.
entries.what_en: Company that packs and sells honey.

entries.name: Tuchel & Sohn GmbH
entries.what_it: Acquista e vende miele di vari paesi, con attenzione alle qualità biologica e Fairtrade.
entries.what_en: Buys and sells honey from several countries, with a focus on organic and Fairtrade qualities.

entries.name: Walter Lang GmbH
entries.what_it: Lavora e confeziona miele biologico e altri dolcificanti, compreso miele di manuka.
entries.what_en: Processes and packs organic honey and other sweeteners, including manuka honey.

entries.name: Mielso S.A.
entries.what_it: Confeziona il miele nel proprio stabilimento, lo distribuisce all'ingrosso e lo esporta.
entries.what_en: Packs honey at its own plant, distributes it wholesale and exports it.

entries.name: Famille Michaud Apiculteurs
entries.what_it: Seleziona e confeziona miele di varia origine, venduto con propri marchi e fornito anche a industrie alimentari e ristorazione.
entries.what_en: Selects and packs honey from various origins, sold under its own brands and also supplied to food manufacturers and foodservice.

entries.name: Littleover Apiaries Ltd
entries.what_it: Ha una divisione che confeziona miele in grandi quantità per catering e industria, anche con miscele su misura.
entries.what_en: Has a division that packs honey in large quantities for catering and industry, also with custom blends.

entries.name: Rowse Honey
entries.what_it: Marchio e azienda di miele che importa e confeziona miele di varie origini e miele britannico.
entries.what_en: Honey brand and company that packs honey from several origins and from UK producers.

entries.name: Tropical Forest Products
entries.what_it: Vende miele sfuso per l'industria alimentare e cosmetica, oltre ad altri prodotti naturali.
entries.what_en: Sells bulk honey for food and cosmetics manufacturers, besides other natural products.

entries.name: Attiki Bee Culturing Co. (Alexandros Pittas)
entries.what_it: Vende miele dell'Attica, insieme a halva, dolci e pappa reale.
entries.what_en: Sells honey from Attica, together with halva, sweets and royal jelly.

entries.name: Magyar Méz Manufaktúra
entries.what_it: Acquista miele da aziende agricole controllate, lo confeziona e lo vende online, a rivenditori in Ungheria e all'estero e ad aziende; fa anche produzione per conto terzi.
entries.what_en: Buys honey from controlled farms, packs it and sells it online, to resellers in Hungary and abroad and to companies; also does contract packing for others.

entries.name: Honey and Spice (Bonneterre Foods Private Limited)
entries.what_it: Acquista miele indiano, lo controlla, lo confeziona e lo esporta in grandi quantità, anche per marchi altrui.
entries.what_en: Sources Indian honey, checks it, packs it and exports it in bulk, including for other brands to repack.

entries.name: UAB Medaus pirkliai
entries.what_it: Acquista miele naturale, lo lavora, lo confeziona e lo vende all'ingrosso.
entries.what_en: Buys natural honey, processes and packs it and sells it wholesale.

entries.name: Apifera
entries.what_it: Acquista miele da apicoltori in Moldova, lo lavora e lo vende soprattutto all'estero, sfuso e confezionato.
entries.what_en: Buys honey from beekeepers in Moldova, processes it and sells it mostly abroad, in bulk and packed.

entries.name: Casa Albinei
entries.what_it: Produce e vende miele naturale e altri prodotti dell'apiario; dichiara di esportare in diversi paesi.
entries.what_en: Produces and sells natural honey and other bee products; states it exports to several countries.

entries.name: MIMIEL (Integradora Agroindustrial MIRA)
entries.what_it: Vende miele confezionato e sfuso, anche con marchio del cliente, dallo Yucatán.
entries.what_en: Sells packed and bulk honey, including private label, from Yucatán.

entries.name: TjalmaHoning
entries.what_it: Importa miele da vari paesi e lo vende all'ingrosso a negozi, ristoranti, panifici e grandi acquirenti.
entries.what_en: Imports honey from various countries and sells it wholesale to shops, restaurants, bakeries and large buyers.

entries.name: Honey New Zealand
entries.what_it: Gestisce l'intera filiera del miele di manuka, dagli alveari all'estrazione, confezionamento ed esportazione.
entries.what_en: Runs the whole manuka honey chain from hives to extraction, packing and export.

entries.name: Mānuka Health (Mānuka Health New Zealand Ltd.)
entries.what_it: Cura alveari propri ed estrae, lavora e imbottiglia miele di manuka nello stabilimento di Te Awamutu.
entries.what_en: Keeps its own hives and extracts, processes and bottles manuka honey at its Te Awamutu facility.

entries.name: Waitemata Honey
entries.what_it: Produce, lavora e confeziona miele neozelandese e spedisce anche all'estero su richiesta.
entries.what_en: Produces, processes and packs New Zealand honey and also ships abroad on request.

entries.name: Gospodarstwo Pasieczne "Sądecki Bartnik" sp. z o.o.
entries.what_it: Ha apiari propri e un servizio di acquisto del miele; vende mieli naturali in vari formati.
entries.what_en: Has its own apiaries and a honey purchasing service; sells natural honeys in several formats.

entries.name: Apisland
entries.what_it: Azienda di Aljezur che vende miele sfuso soprattutto all'estero e ha anche un marchio per vasetti.
entries.what_en: Aljezur company that sells bulk honey mainly for export and also has a jar brand.

entries.name: Serramel (Euromel, Lda)
entries.what_it: Azienda apicola familiare che produce e vende miele e prodotti a base di miele.
entries.what_en: Family beekeeping business that produces and sells honey and honey-based products.

entries.name: Apidava
entries.what_it: Lavora e confeziona miele di varie qualità e prodotti a base di miele.
entries.what_en: Processes and packs honey of several kinds and honey-based products.

entries.name: Timomed d.o.o.
entries.what_it: Produce, lavora e confeziona miele e altri prodotti dell'alveare; secondo il suo sito esporta miele serbo verso UE, USA e Medio Oriente.
entries.what_en: Produces, processes and packs honey and other hive products; its site says it exports Serbian honey to the EU, the USA and the Middle East.

entries.name: Tisacoop
entries.what_it: Confeziona miele naturale nel proprio impianto con il marchio Tiszamed.
entries.what_en: Packs natural honey in its own honey plant under the Tiszamed brand.

entries.name: Honey Polyplus Co., Ltd.
entries.what_it: Produce ed esporta miele naturale (longan, millefiori, litchi) e offre vendita all'ingrosso e marchio per conto terzi.
entries.what_en: Produces and exports natural honey (longan, wildflower, lychee) and offers wholesale and OEM branding.

entries.name: Altıparmak Gıda Sanayi ve Ticaret A.Ş. (Balparmak)
entries.what_it: Azienda proprietaria del marchio di miele Balparmak.
entries.what_en: Company that owns the Balparmak honey brand.

entries.name: Organic Export (ТОВ «Органік Експорт»)
entries.what_it: Acquista miele direttamente dagli apicoltori, lo lavora e lo fornisce a compratori esteri e al mercato interno, anche con marchio del cliente.
entries.what_en: Buys honey directly from beekeepers, processes it and supplies foreign buyers and the home market, including private label.

entries.name: Bee Well Honey Farm
entries.what_it: Vende online miele grezzo sfuso, anche in fusti, prodotto nel sud-est degli Stati Uniti.
entries.what_en: Sells raw bulk honey online, including drums, produced in the south-eastern US.

entries.name: Natural Honey Importers
entries.what_it: Importa e fornisce miele di vari paesi, anche sfuso in fusti, con analisi in laboratorio.
entries.what_en: Imports and supplies honey from several countries, also in bulk drums, with laboratory testing.

entries.name: An Ti Company Limited (Viethoney)
entries.what_it: Azienda di Ho Chi Minh City che produce e commercia miele puro e lo esporta, con marchio Viethoney.
entries.what_en: Ho Chi Minh City company that produces, trades and exports pure honey under the Viethoney brand.

entries.name: Tam Dao Bee Joint Stock Company (Honeco)
entries.what_it: Azienda vietnamita (Honeco) che produce miele e prodotti dell'alveare e li vende anche all'estero.
entries.what_en: Vietnamese company (Honeco) that produces honey and bee products and also sells them abroad.
